name: HAT-P-4
description: Star of 5,860 K, 320 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: HAT-P-4
quotes.card: HAT-P-4 is a wide binary star consisting of a pair of G-type main-sequence stars in the constellation of Boötes.
quotes.introduction: It also has the BD designation BD+36°2593.
